game.name: Update Proton CachyOS
game.desc: Updates the Proton-CachyOS (ARM64) Steam compatibility tool in place, without re-running the full "Install Steam" routine. Fetches the latest arm64 release from github.com/CachyOS/proton-cachyos, patches it for ARM (removes the require_tool_appid line that otherwise makes Steam fail with "unable to launch the compatibility tool"), and keeps the version you had as a one-press rollback copy. The download is verified and validated before it goes live. Idempotent: skips if you already have the latest. Fully relaunch Steam afterwards.

game.name: Rollback Proton CachyOS
game.desc: Switches the Proton-CachyOS (ARM64) compatibility tool back to the version kept by "Update Proton CachyOS". If both a live and a previous version exist it swaps them, so you can toggle back and forth; if only the saved one exists it restores it. Use this if a freshly updated Proton-CachyOS misbehaves. Fully relaunch Steam afterwards.
